title: Move CSV rerun status into Home summary
summary: Moved active CSV rerun progress into the Home summary surfaces: topbar activity, Pipeline card, Current Item card, Live Run status panel, and Next 5 Videos activity rows.
reason: Operators need to see what CSV rerun is importing, what is currently staged, and whether processing has begun without opening Evidence.
behavior_before: CSV rerun details were mainly visible through the Live Run evidence/worker detail, while Home summary cards still looked idle or unrelated to the active CSV staging work.
behavior_after: While CSV rerun is active, Home shows a CSV state pill, current import filename, CSV row counts, Pipeline=CSV Rerun active, Current Item=current importing file, and Next 5 Videos rows for importing, last imported, processing state, and CSV row totals.
manual_validation: In-app browser screenshots confirmed CSV rerun status in topbar, Pipeline card, Current Item card, and Next 5 Videos activity rows.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView Home/topbar/static test changes from this packet and refresh generated summaries for the reverted files.
notes:
CSV rerun status now populates Home topbar, Pipeline card, Current Item card, Live Run status panel, and Next 5 Videos activity rows.
Static tests cover the CSV active override for Home summary placement and non-evidence Live Run status.
Generated summaries refreshed for changed WebView source and test files.
